people.name: Cilicia
people.line: Province in Asia Minor; Paul's birthplace and ministry area

people.name: Gamaliel
people.line: Pharisee; teacher of the law; Paul's mentor.

people.name: Tarsus
people.line: City in Cilicia, birthplace of the apostle Paul

translations.web: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
translations.bsb: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.
translations.kjv: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
